scope: Update the method direction after G33 and the latest 2026 head-avatar literature scan.

literature_signal.name: FFAvatar
literature_signal.implication: Few-shot feed-forward Gaussian head reconstruction now uses multi-view fusion, FLAME prediction, and high-quality 360 capture fine-tuning; this supports learned-prior redesign over ad hoc RI3D iteration scaling.

literature_signal.name: OMEGA-Avatar
literature_signal.implication: One-shot 360 full-head Gaussian avatars are framed as feed-forward, full-head, animation-ready systems with semantic mesh deformation and multi-view feature splatting.

literature_signal.name: OMG-Avatar
literature_signal.implication: Recent work emphasizes transformer features, depth-buffer-guided local sampling, and multi-region decomposition.

literature_signal.name: PanoLAM
literature_signal.implication: Full-head Gaussian synthesis from one unposed image uses synthetic-data-trained feed-forward priors and FLAME/triplane-style structure.

literature_signal.name: LAM
literature_signal.implication: A strong single-image Gaussian-head baseline already exists; repo work should not claim novelty as merely one-shot Gaussian head output.

literature_signal.name: RI3D
literature_signal.implication: RI3D is appropriate for coherent sparse inputs with repair/inpainting priors, not for malformed pseudo-view candidate pools or quality claims after init-level metrics.

method_decision: Do not scale current RI3D iterations as the next method.
Use current RI3D results as numerical/diagnostic evidence.
If implementation continues, the next minimal method should be feed-forward or learned-prior anchored: LAM/PanoLAM/OMEGA/FFAvatar style, with real-GT held-out metrics and VLM/manual gates.
Pseudo views can only re-enter as audited conditional priors, never as ground-truth training views.
next_allowed_milestone: Acquire or construct a benchmark/method premise that can pass PASS_REAL_GT_BENCHMARK plus method-specific preflight; otherwise stop at paper packaging.
artifact_policy: No new media was generated for this method direction gate.
